The verb to be: am / is / are.explain_en: The verb “to be” helps us say who we are, how we feel and where things are. In English we always need it: we say “I am happy”, not “I happy”.
The verb to be: am / is / are.explain_ar: فعل “to be” بيساعدنا نقول إحنا مين، وحاسين بإيه، والحاجات فين. في الإنجليزي لازم نستخدمه دايماً: نقول “I am happy” مش “I happy”.
The verb to be: am / is / are.board: I am · You are · He / She / It is

check.question: Which sentence is correct?
check.why_ar: لازم فعل to be، ومع I بنستخدم am.

The verb to be: am / is / are.explain_en: Use “am” only with I. Use “is” with he, she, it and one person or thing. Use “are” with you, we, they and many people or things.
The verb to be: am / is / are.explain_ar: am مع I بس. is مع he وshe وit وأي شخص أو حاجة واحدة. are مع you وwe وthey وأي أكتر من واحد.
The verb to be: am / is / are.board:
I → am
he / she / it → is · you / we / they → are

check.question: My brothers ___ tall.
check.why_ar: brothers جمع، فبنستخدم are.

The verb to be: am / is / are.explain_en: In speaking we often use short forms: I’m, you’re, he’s. To say no, add “not”: I am not → I’m not, she is not → she isn’t, they are not → they aren’t.
The verb to be: am / is / are.explain_ar: في الكلام بنختصر: I’m وyou’re وhe’s. وللنفي بنضيف not: I’m not وshe isn’t وthey aren’t.
The verb to be: am / is / are.board: I’m not · he isn’t · we aren’t

check.question: Choose the correct negative:
check.why_ar: النفي مع is بيكون isn’t، مش not لوحدها ولا don’t.

The verb to be: am / is / are.explain_en: To ask a question, put am, is or are first: “Are you ready?”, “Is he your teacher?”. Answer short: “Yes, I am.” or “No, he isn’t.”
The verb to be: am / is / are.explain_ar: عشان نسأل، بنحط am أو is أو are في الأول: “Are you ready?”. والإجابة القصيرة: “Yes, I am.” أو “No, he isn’t.”
The verb to be: am / is / are.board: Are you …? → Yes, I am. / No, I’m not.

examples.en: Are you from Egypt? — Yes, I am.
Is it your bag? — No, it isn’t.

check.question: “___ your parents at home?” — “Yes, they are.”
check.why_ar: parents جمع، فالسؤال يبدأ بـ Are.

The verb to be: am / is / are.recap_en: We use am with I, is with one person or thing, and are with you, we and they. Put the verb first to ask a question, and add not to say no.

Present simple: I play / she plays.explain_en: We use the present simple for habits, routines and facts — things that happen again and again or are always true.
Present simple: I play / she plays.explain_ar: بنستخدم المضارع البسيط للعادات والروتين والحقائق: حاجات بتحصل كتير أو صحيحة دايماً.

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.

check.question: Which sentence is a habit?
check.why_ar: every Friday بتدل على عادة، فده مضارع بسيط.

Present simple: I play / she plays.explain_en: With I, you, we and they, use the verb as it is: I play. With he, she and it, add -s: she plays. Some verbs add -es: watch → watches, go → goes.
Present simple: I play / she plays.explain_ar: مع I وyou وwe وthey الفعل زي ما هو. ومع he وshe وit بنضيف s: she plays. وأفعال بتاخد es زي watches وgoes.
Present simple: I play / she plays.board:
I / you / we / they + play
he / she / it + plays

examples.en: My mum watches TV at night.

check.question: My father ___ to work by car.
check.why_ar: father = he، فبنضيف es على go.

Present simple: I play / she plays.explain_en: To say no, use “don’t” with I, you, we, they and “doesn’t” with he, she, it. After doesn’t, the verb has no -s: she doesn’t like fish.
Present simple: I play / she plays.explain_ar: للنفي: don’t مع I وyou وwe وthey، وdoesn’t مع he وshe وit. وبعد doesn’t الفعل من غير s.
Present simple: I play / she plays.board: I don’t play · she doesn’t play

check.question: Choose the correct sentence:
check.why_ar: بعد doesn’t الفعل بيرجع لأصله من غير s.

Present simple: I play / she plays.explain_en: Ask with “Do” or “Does” at the start: “Do you like sport?”, “Does she work here?”. Again, no -s after does. Answer: “Yes, I do.” / “No, she doesn’t.”
Present simple: I play / she plays.explain_ar: بنسأل بـ Do أو Does في الأول: “Do you like sport?”. ومفيش s بعد does. والإجابة: “Yes, I do.”

examples.en: Do you speak English? — Yes, I do.
Does your sister read books? — Yes, she does.

check.question: “___ your brother play tennis?”
check.why_ar: brother = he، فالسؤال بـ Does.

Present simple: I play / she plays.recap_en: Use the present simple for habits and facts. Add -s with he, she and it, use don’t or doesn’t to say no, and do or does to ask.

a / an / the.explain_en: Use “a” or “an” for one thing when we first talk about it. Use “a” before a consonant sound (a book) and “an” before a vowel sound (an apple).
a / an / the.explain_ar: بنستخدم a أو an مع حاجة واحدة أول مرة نتكلم عنها. a قبل صوت ساكن (a book)، وan قبل صوت متحرك (an apple).
a / an / the.board: a + consonant sound · an + a, e, i, o, u sound

check.question: I want ___ egg, please.
check.why_ar: egg بتبدأ بصوت متحرك e، فبنستخدم an.

a / an / the.explain_en: Use “the” when we both know which thing we mean, or when there is only one: the sun, the door of this room. After we say “a dog”, next time we say “the dog”.
a / an / the.explain_ar: بنستخدم the لما نكون عارفين بنتكلم عن أنهي حاجة، أو لما تكون حاجة واحدة بس زي the sun. أول مرة a dog، والمرة اللي بعدها the dog.
a / an / the.board: first time → a · we know which → the

examples.en: I saw a dog. The dog was big.

check.question: “Look at ___ moon! It’s beautiful.”
check.why_ar: القمر واحد بس، فبنقول the moon.

a / an / the.explain_en: We don’t use a/an with plural or uncountable things in general: “I like cats”, “Water is important”. In Arabic we say “القطط” but in English we just say “cats”.
a / an / the.explain_ar: مش بنستخدم a أو an مع الجمع أو الحاجات اللي ما بتتعدش لما نتكلم بشكل عام. بالعربي بنقول “القطط”، لكن بالإنجليزي بنقول cats بس من غير the.

check.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: I love the books in general.
check.why_ar: بنتكلم عن الكتب عموماً، فمش محتاجين the ولا a.

a / an / the.explain_en: Use a/an with jobs: “She is a teacher.” Arabic speakers often forget it. Use “the” with some places we all know: the bank, the cinema, the airport.
a / an / the.explain_ar: بنستخدم a أو an مع الوظايف: “She is a teacher.” وكتير بننساها. وبنستخدم the مع أماكن معروفة زي the bank وthe airport.
a / an / the.board: She is a doctor. · I’m going to the bank.

check.question: My uncle is ___ pilot.
check.why_ar: وظيفة لشخص واحد، وpilot بتبدأ بصوت ساكن، فـ a.

a / an / the.recap_en: Use a or an for one thing the first time, and an before vowel sounds. Use the when we know which one, and no article for things in general.

Plurals: cat → cats, child → children.explain_en: To talk about more than one thing, we usually add -s: one cat, two cats. Numbers like two, three and many need the plural.
Plurals: cat → cats, child → children.explain_ar: عشان نتكلم عن أكتر من حاجة، غالباً بنضيف s: one cat وtwo cats. وبعد الأرقام وmany لازم الجمع.

examples.en: There are many cars in the street.

check.question: I have three ___.
check.why_ar: بعد three لازم جمع، وpen بتاخد s.

Plurals: cat → cats, child → children.explain_en: Words ending in s, sh, ch, x or o often add -es: bus → buses, box → boxes. A consonant + y changes to -ies: baby → babies, city → cities.
Plurals: cat → cats, child → children.explain_ar: الكلمات اللي آخرها s أو sh أو ch أو x أو o غالباً بتاخد es. ولو آخرها حرف ساكن + y بتبقى ies: babies وcities.

check.question: What is the plural of “family”?
check.why_ar: y بعد حرف ساكن بتتغير لـ ies.

Plurals: cat → cats, child → children.explain_en: Some words change completely: child → children, man → men, woman → women, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, person → people, mouse → mice.
Plurals: cat → cats, child → children.explain_ar: كلمات بتتغير خالص في الجمع: children وmen وwomen وfeet وteeth وpeople وmice. لازم نحفظها.

check.question: There are twenty ___ in the room.
check.why_ar: جمع person هو people.

Plurals: cat → cats, child → children.explain_en: A plural subject needs a plural verb: “The boys are”, “My feet hurt”. Some words have no plural: information, advice, homework.
Plurals: cat → cats, child → children.explain_ar: الفاعل الجمع بياخد فعل جمع: The boys are. وفيه كلمات مالهاش جمع زي information وadvice وhomework.

examples.en: I have a lot of homework.

check.question: Choose the correct sentence:
check.why_ar: women جمع، فالفعل are.

Plurals: cat → cats, child → children.recap_en: Most nouns add -s, some add -es or -ies, and some change completely like children and people. A plural noun needs a plural verb.

There is / There are.explain_en: We use “there is” and “there are” to say that something exists or is in a place: “There is a park near my house.”
There is / There are.explain_ar: بنستخدم there is وthere are عشان نقول إن فيه حاجة موجودة في مكان: “There is a park near my house.”
There is / There are.board: There is = فيه (واحد) · There are = فيه (أكتر)

examples.en: There is a cat on the sofa.
There are two parks in my town.

check.question: Which means “فيه كتاب على الترابيزة”?
options: It is a book on the table.
There is a book on the table.
Have a book on the table.
check.why_ar: للوجود بنقول there is، مش it is ولا have.

There is / There are.explain_en: Use “there is” with one thing or uncountable things (there is some water). Use “there are” with plurals (there are three chairs).
There is / There are.explain_ar: there is مع حاجة واحدة أو حاجة ما بتتعدش زي water. وthere are مع الجمع.
There is / There are.board: There is a / some water · There are three / some apples

examples.en: There is some milk in the fridge.

check.question: ___ five students in the class.
check.why_ar: students جمع، فـ There are.

There is / There are.explain_en: To say no, use “there isn’t” and “there aren’t”. We often use “any” with them: “There aren’t any shops here.”
There is / There are.explain_ar: للنفي: there isn’t وthere aren’t، وغالباً بنستخدم any معاهم: “There aren’t any shops here.”
There is / There are.board: There isn’t a … · There aren’t any …

examples.en: There isn’t a bank near here.

check.question: Choose the correct sentence:
check.why_ar: chairs جمع، فالنفي there aren’t any.

There is / There are.explain_en: Ask with “Is there…?” or “Are there…?”: “Is there a toilet here?”, “Are there any buses to the airport?”. Answer: “Yes, there is.” / “No, there aren’t.”
There is / There are.explain_ar: بنسأل بـ Is there أو Are there في الأول، والإجابة: “Yes, there is.” أو “No, there aren’t.”

examples.en: Is there a pharmacy near here? — Yes, there is.
Are there any questions? — No, there aren’t.

check.question: “___ any restaurants in this street?”
check.why_ar: restaurants جمع، والسؤال بيبدأ بـ Are there.

There is / There are.recap_en: Use there is for one thing and there are for plurals. Say no with isn’t or aren’t, and ask with Is there or Are there.

Can / can’t.explain_en: We use “can” to say we are able to do something, and “can’t” when we are not: “I can swim. I can’t drive.”
Can / can’t.explain_ar: بنستخدم can عشان نقول إننا نقدر نعمل حاجة، وcan’t لما مانقدرش: “I can swim. I can’t drive.”

examples.en: My sister can sing very well.

check.question: Which sentence means “أقدر أتكلم إنجليزي”?
check.why_ar: بعد can الفعل في أصله من غير to ومن غير s.

Can / can’t.explain_en: Can is the same for all people — no -s with he or she — and the next verb has no “to”: “She can play”, not “She cans play” or “She can to play”.
Can / can’t.explain_ar: can ثابتة مع الكل، مفيش s مع he أو she، والفعل اللي بعدها من غير to: “She can play”.

check.question: Choose the correct sentence:
check.why_ar: can مش بتتغير، والفعل بعدها في أصله.

Can / can’t.explain_en: Ask with Can first: “Can you help me?”. We also use can to ask for permission: “Can I open the window?”. Answer: “Yes, you can.” / “Sorry, you can’t.”
Can / can’t.explain_ar: بنسأل بـ Can في الأول: “Can you help me?”. وبنستخدمها كمان نستأذن: “Can I open the window?”

examples.en: Can I sit here? — Yes, of course.

check.question: You want to borrow a pen. You say:
options: Can I to borrow your pen?
check.why_ar: السؤال بيبدأ بـ Can، والفعل بعدها من غير to.

Can / can’t.explain_en: In a shop or café, “can” makes you sound polite and friendly: “Can I have a coffee, please?”, “Can you show me the blue one?”
Can / can’t.explain_ar: في المحل أو الكافيه، can بتخليك مؤدب ولطيف: “Can I have a coffee, please?”

examples.en: Can I have the bill, please?
Can you tell me the way to the station?

check.question: In a café, the most polite choice is:
options: Can I have some water, please?
check.why_ar: Can I have … please طريقة مؤدبة للطلب.

Can / can’t.recap_en: Use can and can’t to talk about ability, with no -s and no to after it. Put can first to ask, and use “Can I…?” to ask politely.
